title: Quantum-Resilient Signature: Reproducible Design-Space Study of Lightweight Lattice-Based Authentication and Signatures for Blockchain Transactions
description: Reproducible experiments (Track A symmetric LWE tag; Track B Lyubashevsky-style public-key lattice signature), parameter-instantiation methodology (root-Hermite/core-SVP estimator + scaled-down LLL embedding attacks), benchmark aligned with 2025-2026 PQC evaluation methodology. Teaching-level security estimates; not formal proofs. See README and docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
